title: RD lookup constructor silently overwrites /rd-lookup/res on second RD
description: ResourceDirectoryResource.__init__ always site.add_resource([rd-lookup, res], ...). aiocoap Site.add_resource overwrites. Two RD instances on one site leave POST /rd on the first RD and GET /rd-lookup/res on the second (empty). build_site constructs once so default path is fine. Guard double-mount or bind lookup to the same instance as /rd.
